# RxPDF Cool

> Free, 100% client-side PDF toolkit. Nine tools — split, merge, compress, PDF to images, watermark, page numbers, sign, edit, protect and unlock — run entirely in the browser. Files are never uploaded; all processing happens on the device.

## What it is

RxPDF Cool is a static web application (HTML + CSS + vanilla JavaScript) for working with PDF files. Every operation is performed locally with pdf.js (rendering), @cantoo/pdf-lib (reading, writing, AES-256 encryption) and JSZip (archives). There is no backend, no account, no upload endpoint, no telemetry and no analytics. It can be installed as a PWA and used fully offline.

- Website: https://pdf.rxdiag.my.id/
- Source: https://github.com/abidzk01/cool-pdf
- License: MIT (https://github.com/abidzk01/cool-pdf/blob/master/LICENSE)
- Languages: English and Indonesian

## Tools

- Split: https://pdf.rxdiag.my.id/?tab=split — extract, reorder, rotate, delete and cut pages into parts
- Merge: https://pdf.rxdiag.my.id/?tab=merge — combine up to 50 PDFs in a chosen order
- Compress: https://pdf.rxdiag.my.id/?tab=compress — lossless re-save, Balanced (150 DPI), Small (100 DPI), target size (KB/MB), or percentage of the original
- PDF to images: https://pdf.rxdiag.my.id/?tab=images — PNG/JPEG at up to 216 DPI, bundled as ZIP
- Watermark: https://pdf.rxdiag.my.id/?tab=watermark — text, size, colour, opacity and position
- Page numbers: https://pdf.rxdiag.my.id/?tab=pagenums — start number, five positions, font size
- Protect: https://pdf.rxdiag.my.id/?tab=protect — AES-256 password encryption
- Unlock: https://pdf.rxdiag.my.id/?tab=unlock — remove a password you know
- Edit: https://pdf.rxdiag.my.id/?tab=edit — draw a signature with mouse/touch, add text, images, shapes, ink, highlights or cover boxes; rotate/duplicate/insert/delete pages; edit metadata

## Facts for citations

- 100% client-side: no file ever leaves the browser; there is no server-side processing.
- Limits: up to 1.5 GB and about 3,000 pages, subject to available RAM.
- Password protection uses real AES-256 (ISO 32000-2 R6) through @cantoo/pdf-lib.
- Lossy compression modes rasterize pages, so text is no longer selectable; Lossless keeps text.
- The app is a PWA: installable from the browser address bar and usable offline after the first visit.
- The only persisted value is the UI language (`localStorage["rxpdf.lang"]`); no PDF data, filename or password is stored.
- Supported browsers: Chrome/Edge 90+, Firefox 88+, Safari 14+.
